title: Human Overview
description: The interactive guide to the knowledge hub, helping you understand its structure and explore how ideas connect across the ecosystem.

children.title: Playbook
children.description: A living collection of contributor-built modules for building microproducts that turn data into value, moving from shared foundations into the analytics development lifecycle: frame, build, and operate.

children.title: Frame
children.description: The planning layer of the analytics development lifecycle, organizing content around defining opportunities, understanding users, scoping microproducts, and analyzing whether an idea is worth building.

children.title: Frame
children.description: Validate whether a microproduct is worth building and feasible to deliver before execution.

children.title: Ideation
children.description: Identify demand, available data, and the minimum useful outcome before the product shape hardens.

children.title: Design
children.description: Translate requirements and learnings into concrete specifications before implementation.

children.title: Architecture
children.description: Choose the pipeline, storage, serving model, and operating constraints that can support the product.

children.title: Data Stack & Analytics Engineering
children.description: Apply software engineering discipline to data workflows so the product can be tested, refreshed, observed, and reused.

children.title: Build
children.description: The development layer of the analytics development lifecycle, organizing content around designing, developing, testing, and deploying microproducts through iterative implementation.

children.title: Build
children.description: Execute, validate quality, and deliver a reliable MVP through focused delivery workflows.

children.title: Delivery Workflow
children.description: Translate validated scope into focused build tasks and working product slices.

children.title: QA Methodology
children.description: Use quality gates, behavior-driven checks, and review norms to keep AI-assisted builds reliable.

children.title: Release
children.description: Key release-readiness criteria, including a graph of how these relate to other components of the playbook.

children.title: Deploy Quickstart
children.description: Ship your microproduct for free using only GitHub and the Vercel Hobby plan.

children.title: Operate
children.description: The operational layer of the analytics development lifecycle, organizing content around operating, observing, learning from, and improving shipped microproducts over time.

children.title: Operate
children.description: Own distribution, learning, and iteration after launch so the product keeps improving.

children.title: Resources
children.description: Curated references that help builders execute faster without changing the playbook hierarchy.

children.title: Authors
children.description: The people and organizations listed in the shared author registry for the docs.
